summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Education to establish a grant program for states to facilitate tuition-free community college for eligible students, provide subgrants to institutions for supportive services, and offer direct grants to students for non-tuition costs, requiring states to submit plans detailing interagency coordination, educational alignment, and strategies for credential attainment and student support.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on education, specifically establishing a program to facilitate tuition-free community college, provide grants for institutional capacity, and offer emergency aid to students. This directly increases spending on public education at the postsecondary level.
